reviews.title: Very cool!
reviews.comment: Arrived in great condition, in really cool packaging! Easy to install and works fine, really quiet, powers three monitors ( albeit low quality monitors ). I'm happy with the product so far, as it has performed for me without any issue, but I'm not a gamer, so I don't know how to quantify it for that purpose, but I have run some large language models on it and it has performed beautifully. Not sure how much these should cost, but I think this seemed like a really competitive price when I purchased it. Fairly certain that I have come nowhere near close to maxing this device out.
reviews.author: kevin perkins

reviews.title: Shipped quick and secure
reviews.comment: What a huge purchase! But I don’t regret my investment if you are a serious gamer or game dev. The card is huge and performs like a pedigree stallion out of the box. Vampire Survivors never looked so good…….. Jk it purrs whether I’m maxing out a AAA game or sculpting a ridiculously high poly mesh in Blender. UE 5.4 has been good to me too on my machine (with an i9 chip). If you’ve been putting in the work- invest in your craft! But only if you can make the monthly payment..
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Buy tech from Amazon, 4090 is unstoppable.
reviews.comment: Im just gonna make this simple. The Nvidia GeForce RTX 4090 is straight up the best graphics card that you can buy, and buying it from amazon was a great idea because of Its great price (compared to other 3rd party retailers), and quality control. For me I'm getting 1 frame per dollar, so $2000, 2000 FPS, but I only recommend this card if you are gaming at 4K with ultra graphics settings, if you want a decent 4K card, go for the 7900XTX or the 4080 Super.
